ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- if (payload.flights != null and sizeOf(payload.flights) > 0) payload else error("INVALID_INPUT", "Flight records array is required and must not be empty")

logger.doc:name: Log Processing Start
logger.message: Processing flight record: #[payload.flightNumber default 'UNKNOWN'] - Record Index: #[payload.recordIndex]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { flightId: if (payload.flightId != null and payload.flightId != "") payload.flightId else uuid(), flightNumber: payload.flightNumber default error("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Flight number is required"), airline: payload.airline default "American Airlines", departure: { airport: payload.departure.airport default error("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Departure airport is required"), city: payload.departure.city default "", scheduledTime: payload.departure.scheduledTime default error("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Departure scheduled time is required"), actualTime: payload.departure.actualTime default null, gate: payload.departure.gate default null, terminal: payload.departure.terminal default null }, arrival: { airport: payload.arrival.airport default error("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Arrival airport is required"), city: payload.arrival.city default "", scheduledTime: payload.arrival.scheduledTime default error("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Arrival scheduled time is required"), actualTime: payload.arrival.actualTime default null, gate: payload.arrival.gate default null, terminal: payload.arrival.terminal default null }, aircraft: { 'type': payload.aircraft.'type' default "", registration: payload.aircraft.registration default "", capacity: payload.aircraft.capacity default 0 }, status: upper(payload.status default "SCHEDULED"), price: payload.price default 0.0, currency: upper(payload.currency default "USD"), duration: payload.duration default "", distance: payload.distance default 0, batchId: payload.batchId, recordIndex: payload.recordIndex, processingTimestamp: payload.processingTimestamp, processedAt: now() }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Failed Record
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO batch_errors ( batch_id, record_index, flight_number, departure_airport, arrival_airport, error_type, error_reason, failed_at, record_data ) VALUES ( :batchId, :recordIndex, :flightNumber, :departureAirport, :arrivalAirport, :errorType, :errorReason, NOW(), :recordData )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ batchId: payload.batchId, recordIndex: payload.recordIndex, flightNumber: payload.flightNumber default "UNKNOWN", departureAirport: payload.departure.airport default "UNKNOWN", arrivalAirport: payload.arrival.airport default "UNKNOWN", errorType: error.errorType.asString(), errorReason: error.description, recordData: write(payload, "application/json") }]

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Flight Record
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO flights ( flight_id, flight_number, airline, departure_airport, departure_city, departure_scheduled_time, departure_actual_time, departure_gate, departure_terminal, arrival_airport, arrival_city, arrival_scheduled_time, arrival_actual_time, arrival_gate, arrival_terminal, aircraft_type, aircraft_registration, aircraft_capacity, status, price, currency, duration, distance, batch_id, record_index, processing_timestamp, processed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :flightId, :flightNumber, :airline, :departureAirport, :departureCity, :departureScheduledTime, :departureActualTime, :departureGate, :departureTerminal, :arrivalAirport, :arrivalCity, :arrivalScheduledTime, :arrivalActualTime, :arrivalGate, :arrivalTerminal, :aircraftType, :aircraftRegistration, :aircraftCapacity, :status, :price, :currency, :duration, :distance, :batchId, :recordIndex, :processingTimestamp, :processedAt, NOW(), NOW() )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ flightId: payload.flightId, flightNumber: payload.flightNumber, airline: payload.airline, departureAirport: payload.departure.airport, departureCity: payload.departure.city, departureScheduledTime: payload.departure.scheduledTime, departureActualTime: payload.departure.actualTime, departureGate: payload.departure.gate, departureTerminal: payload.departure.terminal, arrivalAirport: payload.arrival.airport, arrivalCity: payload.arrival.city, arrivalScheduledTime: payload.arrival.scheduledTime, arrivalActualTime: payload.arrival.actualTime, arrivalGate: payload.arrival.gate, arrivalTerminal: payload.arrival.terminal, aircraftType: payload.aircraft.'type', aircraftRegistration: payload.aircraft.registration, aircraftCapacity: payload.aircraft.capacity, status: payload.status, price: payload.price, currency: payload.currency, duration: payload.duration, distance: payload.distance, batchId: payload.batchId, recordIndex: payload.recordIndex, processingTimestamp: payload.processingTimestamp as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}, processedAt: payload.processedAt as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"} }]

logger.doc:name: Log Database Insert Success
logger.message: Flight record stored successfully: #[payload.flightNumber] with ID: #[payload.flightId]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var batchJobResult = payload var totalRecords = batchJobResult.totalRecords var successfulRecords = batchJobResult.successfulRecords var failedRecords = batchJobResult.failedRecords var processingTimeMs = ((now() - vars.processingStartTime) as Number) var processingTimeSeconds = processingTimeMs / 1000 --- { batchId: vars.batchId, processingStartTime: vars.processingStartTime, processingEndTime: now(), processingDurationSeconds: processingTimeSeconds, summary: { totalRecords: totalRecords, successfulRecords: successfulRecords, failedRecords: failedRecords, successRate: if (totalRecords > 0) ((successfulRecords / totalRecords) * 100) as Number {format: "##.##"} else 0 }, status: if (failedRecords == 0) "COMPLETED_SUCCESS" else if (successfulRecords > 0) "COMPLETED_WITH_FAILURES" else "COMPLETED_ALL_FAILED" }

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Batch Summary
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO batch_summary ( batch_id, processing_start_time, processing_end_time, total_records, successful_records, failed_records, processing_duration_seconds, success_rate, status, created_at ) VALUES ( :batchId, :processingStartTime, :processingEndTime, :totalRecords, :successfulRecords, :failedRecords, :processingDuration, :successRate, :status, NOW() )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ batchId: vars.batchSummary.batchId, processingStartTime: vars.batchSummary.processingStartTime as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}, processingEndTime: vars.batchSummary.processingEndTime as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}, totalRecords: vars.batchSummary.summary.totalRecords, successfulRecords: vars.batchSummary.summary.successfulRecords, failedRecords: vars.batchSummary.summary.failedRecords, processingDuration: vars.batchSummary.processingDurationSeconds, successRate: vars.batchSummary.summary.successRate, status: vars.batchSummary.status }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { message: "Batch processing completed successfully", batchId: vars.batchSummary.batchId, processingDuration: vars.batchSummary.processingDurationSeconds ++ " seconds", summary: vars.batchSummary.summary, status: vars.batchSummary.status, emailNotificationSent: true, timestamp: now() }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "BATCH_PROCESSING_FAILED", message: "Failed to process flight records batch", details: error.description, batchId: vars.batchId default null, timestamp: now() }

db:select.doc:name: Query Failed Records
db:select.db:sql: SELECT flight_number, record_index, departure_airport, arrival_airport, status, processing_timestamp, 'Validation or processing error during batch execution' as error_reason FROM batch_errors WHERE batch_id = :batchId ORDER BY record_index

ee:message.ee:set-payload:
%dw 2.0 output text/html var summary = vars.batchSummary.summary var failedDetails = vars.failedRecordsDetails default [] var statusColor = if (summary.failedRecords == 0) "green" else if (summary.successfulRecords > 0) "orange" else "red" --- "

Flight Records Batch Processing Complete

Batch ID: " ++ vars.batchSummary.batchId ++ "

Processing Time: " ++ vars.batchSummary.processingDurationSeconds ++ " seconds

Processing Summary

MetricValue
Total Records" ++ summary.totalRecords ++ "
Successfully Processed" ++ summary.successfulRecords ++ "

" ++ (if (sizeOf(failedDetails) > 0) "

Failed Records Details

" ++ (failedDetails reduce ((item, accumulator="") -> accumulator ++ "" )) ++ "
Record #Flight NumberRouteError Reason

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "Flight Records Batch Processing Complete - " ++ vars.batchSummary.summary.totalRecords ++ " records processed (" ++ vars.batchSummary.summary.successfulRecords ++ " success, " ++ vars.batchSummary.summary.failedRecords ++ " failed)"

logger.doc:name: Log Email Sent
logger.message: Batch completion email notification sent successfully for batch: #[vars.batchSummary.batchId]
